entries.title: Leviticus 17:1
segments: ¶And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

entries.title: Leviticus 17:2
segments: "Speak to Aaron, to his sons, and to all the children of Israel, and say to them, 'This [is] the thing which the LORD has commanded, saying:

entries.title: Leviticus 17:3
segments: "Whatever man of the house of Israel who kills an ox or lamb or goat in the camp, or who kills [it] outside the camp,

entries.title: Leviticus 17:4
segments: "and does not bring it to the door of the tabernacle of meeting to offer an offering to the LORD before the tabernacle of the LORD, the guilt of bloodshed shall be imputed to that man. He has shed blood; and that man shall be cut off from among his people,

entries.title: Leviticus 17:5
segments: "to the end that the children of Israel may bring their sacrifices which they offer in the open field, that they may bring them to the LORD at the door of the tabernacle of meeting, to the priest, and offer them [as] peace offerings to the LORD.

entries.title: Leviticus 17:6
segments: "And the priest shall sprinkle the blood on the altar of the LORD [at] the door of the tabernacle of meeting, and burn the fat for a sweet aroma to the LORD.

entries.title: Leviticus 17:7
segments: "They shall no more offer their sacrifices to demons, after whom they have played the harlot. This shall be a statute forever for them throughout their generations."'

entries.title: Leviticus 17:8
segments: "Also you shall say to them: 'Whatever man of the house of Israel, or of the strangers who dwell among you, who offers a burnt offering or sacrifice,

entries.title: Leviticus 17:9
segments: 'and does not bring it to the door of the tabernacle of meeting, to offer it to the LORD, that man shall be cut off from among his people.

entries.title: Leviticus 17:10
segments: ¶'And whatever man of the house of Israel, or of the strangers who dwell among you, who eats any blood, I will set My face against that person who eats blood, and will cut him off from among his people.

entries.title: Leviticus 17:11
segments: 'For the life of the flesh [is] in the blood, and I have given it to you upon the altar to make atonement for your souls; for it [is] the blood [that] makes atonement for the soul.'

entries.title: Leviticus 17:12
segments: "Therefore I said to the children of Israel, 'No one among you shall eat blood, nor shall any stranger who dwells among you eat blood.'

entries.title: Leviticus 17:13
segments: "Whatever man of the children of Israel, or of the strangers who dwell among you, who hunts and catches any animal or bird that may be eaten, he shall pour out its blood and cover it with dust;

entries.title: Leviticus 17:14
segments: "for [it is] the life of all flesh. Its blood sustains its life. Therefore I said to the children of Israel, 'You shall not eat the blood of any flesh, for the life of all flesh is its blood. Whoever eats it shall be cut off.'

entries.title: Leviticus 17:15
segments: "And every person who eats what died [naturally] or what was torn [by beasts, whether he is] a native of your own country or a stranger, he shall both wash his clothes and bathe in water, and be unclean until evening. Then he shall be clean.

entries.title: Leviticus 17:16
segments: "But if he does not wash [them] or bathe his body, then he shall bear his guilt."
